8658.name: USGS CoNED Topobathymetric DEM, Southern Coast of CA & Channel Islands
8658.acquisition: 1930-03-03 .. 2014-12-31; 49 sources, 23 srcinfo blocks in the FGDC. Topography 2005-2014, bathymetry 1930-2014, nearshore voids filled with NOS surveys from 1967 and 2013.
8658.datum_evidence: FGDC Southern_California_Topobathy_DEM_FGDC_Metadata.xml <vertdef>/<altsys>: 'North American Vertical Datum of 1988', resolution 0.001, 'meters', 'Implicit coordinate'.
8658.datum_in_raster: NO. The GeoTIFF has no VerticalCSType GeoKey. It carries VerticalUnits=9001 (metre) and ProjectedCSType=26911 only. The vertical datum exists in the sidecar and nowhere in the pixel container.
8658.horizontal: EPSG:26911 NAD83 / UTM zone 11N (GeoKeys); FGDC names NAD83_NSRS2007

5189.name: 2014 USACE NCMP Topobathy Lidar DEM: California
5189.acquisition: STATED 2014-09-08 .. 2014-10-05, and contradicted by the swath filenames. See acquisition-dates.json.
5189.resolution: nominally 1 m, but the grid is GEOGRAPHIC: 8.99928e-06 deg, which is 0.995 m N-S and 0.843 m E-W at 32.7N. Pixels are not square in ground units.
5189.datum_evidence: GeoTIFF GeoKey VerticalCSType=5703 (EPSG:5703, NAVD88 height, metre); GTCitation 'NAD83(2011) + NAVD88 height'; STAC proj:wkt2 COMPOUNDCRS['NAD83(2011) + NAVD88 height']; FGDC <vertdef> NAVD88 / 0.001 / meters.

9488.name: 2009 USACE NCMP Topobathy Lidar DEM: California
9488.datum_evidence: GeoTIFF GeoKey VerticalCSType=5703; GTCitation 'NAD83 + NAVD88 height'; STAC proj:wkt2 COMPOUNDCRS['NAD83 + NAVD88 height'].

2616.name: 2009-2011 Coastal California TopoBathy Merged Project DEM (with voids)
2616.acquisition: 2009-01-01 .. 2011-01-01 (nominal range only; no finer date published)
2616.datum_evidence: GeoTIFF GeoKey VerticalCSType=5703; GTCitation 'NAD83_NSRS2007_UTM_zone_11N + NAVD88 height'.

8684.name: 2009-2011 Merged Topobathy DEM (INTERPOLATED): Coastal California
8684.vertical_datum: NOT DECLARED IN THE RASTER. Presumed NAVD88 metre from its void-preserving sibling 2616, which is an inference, not evidence.
8684.datum_evidence: NO VerticalCSType GeoKey. GTCitation is 'NAD83(NSRS2007) / UTM zone 11N' with no vertical component, and pixel_scale z = 0.0. Sibling 2616 declares NAVD88; this one does not.
8684.compression: LZW + fp predictor. NOT decoded by this recon.

6260.name: 2016 USGS West Coast El-Nino Lidar DEM (WA, OR, CA)
6260.resolution: 0.5 m (pixel_scale 0.5). The finest of the six, and the only sub-metre one.
6260.datum_evidence: GeoTIFF GeoKey VerticalCSType=5703; GTCitation 'NAD83(2011) / UTM zone 11N + NAVD88 height'.

13968.name: 2014-2015 USGS QL2 Lidar DEM: San Diego, CA (USGS Original Product Resolution)
13968.resolution: 2000 x 2000 px tiles at OPR (as-delivered) resolution
13968.vertical_units: US SURVEY FOOT. The only one of the seven not in metres.
13968.datum_evidence: USGS FGDC USGS_OPR_San_Diego_CA_2014_LiDAR_220010.xml <vertdef>: 'North American Vertical Datum 1988', altres 0.30480060960121924, 'US survey foot'. 0.30480060960121924 is 1200/3937 exactly, confirming the US survey foot rather than the international foot.
13968.note: Topographic QL2 lidar only. No green laser, so no return below the waterline at time of flight. The DAV footprint covers 6 of 8 spots and excludes sunset-cliffs and cabrillo-tidepools.
